announcements: 🏆 Final Update (18th September 2026): Google Cloud Arcade 2026 leaderboard is officially finalized!
🙏 A heartfelt thank you from Facilitators Sachin Upparna & Vikas A. L. for being an amazing part of this journey!
⚠️ Important Notice: This community portal will be officially closed on or before the 2nd week of October 2026.
motivationalMessages: Congratulations on completing your cloud learning journey!
Every Skill Badge earned is real cloud expertise you own forever.
Proud of the dedication and hard work shown by this entire cohort.
Keep learning. Keep building. Keep growing!
Thank you for being part of the Google Cloud Arcade 2026 community.
